## About

An interactive web prototype on the dynamics of mountain forests in the **Berchtesgaden
National Park**, built as an application demo. It combines an interactive map with
structural and dynamic indicators of the park's forest stands to make change over time —
and the drivers behind it — explorable rather than tabular.
